summary: Commit attention controls and their client receipts atomically

replay.detail: A narrow control-write observer can persist the action result and exact post-write revision before commit. Same-key retries preserve the original receipt even after subsequent controls.

schema.detail: No claim or database schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing store callers need no client receipt. An observer failure rolls back both control and receipt, avoiding an acknowledged control without its undo fence.

manual.detail: No public mutation is advertised by this internal write change.

recovery.detail: Retry the same idempotency key after a pre-commit refusal.
